description: This file defines models and a fetcher for Tradier equity search, including query parameters, data validation, and data fetching logic with API interaction.

classes.name: TradierEquitySearchQueryParams
classes.description: Model for Tradier equity search query parameters, including a flag for symbol search.

classes.name: TradierEquitySearchData
classes.description: Model for Tradier equity search results, with validation and aliasing for fields.

classes.name: TradierEquitySearchFetcher
classes.description: Fetcher class for performing Tradier equity searches, including data transformation and API request handling.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a TradierEquitySearchQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches raw data from the Tradier API based on query parameters and credentials.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Transforms raw API data into validated TradierEquitySearchData instances.

methods.name: name_validator
methods.description: Validates and sanitizes the 'name' and 'exchange' fields in the data.
